title: macros
rule: Let users compose a sequence of smaller actions into one reusable macro.

citation.source: Designing Interfaces 3e ch. Doing Things — Macros (Tidwell, Brewer, Valencia)

pass_when: A sequence of smaller actions can be composed into one reusable macro.
fail_when: Repeated sequences cannot be recorded or reused as a macro.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
